thag5.11:1.1: Upasampadā ca me laddhā, vimutto c' amhi anāsavo, so ca me bhagavā diṭṭho, vihāre ca sahāvasiṃ. || ||
thag5.11:2.1: bahud eva rattiṃ bhagavā abbhokāse 'tināmayi, vihārakusalo satthā vihāraṃ pāvisī tadā. || ||
thag5.11:3.1: santharitvāna saṃghāṭiṃ seyyaṃ kappesi Gotamo sīho selaguhāyaṃ va pahīnabhayabheravo. || ||
thag5.11:4.1: tato kalyāṇavākkaraṇo sammāsambuddhasāvako Soṇo abhāsi saddhammaṃ buddhaseṭṭhassa sammukhā || ||
thag5.11:5.1: pañca kkhandhe pariññāya bhāvayitvāna añjasaṃ pappuyya paramaṃ santiṃ parinibbissaty anāsavo 'ti. || || Soṇo Kuṭikaṇṇo
